# The bundled git's ignore corpus (DESIGN-COMPUTE §13.4's ignore row; GIT-M13-01's TestIgnoreCorpus), held against
# stock git's check-ignore --no-index -v -n. The rule files are written here, never as files of this repository, so
# they ignore nothing in it.
#
#   file <name>            the lines that follow, each a Go-quoted string, up to `end`, joined with newlines
#   rawfile <name> <bytes> the file's exact bytes as one Go-quoted string (a BOM, CRLF, no final newline)
#   path f|d <path>        a file or directory made in the worktree and asked about, its path a Go-quoted string
#
# expected.txt and expected-icase.txt hold stock git's answers, core.ignorecase false and true; regenerate them with
# SIDECAR_REGENERATE_GIT_VECTORS=1 where the host has git.

file .git/info/exclude
"*.swp"
"/local-only"
"excluded-by-info"
end

file .gitignore
"# a comment"
"\\#not-a-comment"
"*.log"
"!important.log"
"build/"
"/root-only.txt"
"doc/*.txt"
"doc/**/*.pdf"
"**/cache"
"logs/**"
"!logs/keep/**"
"trailing\\ "
"spaces   "
"a?c"
"[abc]x"
"[!a-c]y"
"[^d-f]w"
"[[:digit:]]z"
"[[:upper:]]u"
"foo/**/bar"
"*.tmp/"
"\\!bang"
"temp*"
"!temp-keep"
""
"   "
"*.[oa]"
"sub/deep/"
"x/**"
"!excluded-by-info"
"*.LOG2"
"mid/*/end"
"**/anywhere/**/file.txt"
"star*star*"
"[a-]dash"
"[]]bracket"
"unclosed["
"back\\slash"
"\\*literal-star"
end

file sub/.gitignore
"*.txt"
"!keep.txt"
"/anchored"
"nested/"
"!important.log"
end

file sub/nested/.gitignore
"!*.txt"
end

rawfile crlf/.gitignore "\xef\xbb\xbfbom-first\r\ncrlf-line\r\n!crlf-keep\r\nno-final-newline"
